rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for sheep fleece and wool as a material.

example.english: This sweater is made of wool.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 laang5 saam1 hai6 joeng4 mou4 zik1 gaa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when the wool has been made into yarn rather than referring to wool in general.

example.english: Mum bought some wool to knit scarves.
example.traditional: 阿媽買咗幾卷羊毛線織頸巾。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 maai5 zo2 gei2 gyun2 joeng4 mou4 sin3 zik1 geng2 gan1
